title: Umutwaro Wazanye Gukira
intro: Roho yageragejwe cyane yambuwe ihumure, inshuti, n'imbaraga z'umubiri. Uyu mugaragu wa Allah yari mu kaga gakomeye, yihindukiriye Imana gusa. Binyuze mu kwihangana gukomeye n'isengesho rivuye ku mutima, haje umuraba w'imbabazi urenze ibyo abantu bose bari biteze. Ni nde uyu muntu wiyeguriye Imana wafunguye umuryango wo kugarura ubuzima?
clues: Nari umugaragu w’Imana ukundwa, nishimira uburumbuke, urugo rusagamba, kandi mfite ubuzima bwiza mu gihe cyanjye.
Hanyuma ikigeragezo kiraza: ubutunzi buragenda, abakunzi banjye baragiye, kandi umubiri wanjye warakubiswe n'imibabaro ikomeye.
Abari hafi yanjye ntibashoboye kwihanganira imimerere yanjye, maze nsigara ndi wenyine, umubiri wanjye wuzuye imibabaro.
Nahamagaye Umwami wanjye, mbwira ko Satani yankozeho umunaniro n'igihano.
Igisubizo cyaje — itegeko ryo gukubita hasi n'ikirenge cyanjye, maze amazi akonje aturukamo kugira ngo akire.
Umwami wanjye yankuyeho burundu ingorane maze ansubiza umuryango wanjye, ugwiza, nk'ikimenyetso cy'imbabazi ku batekereza.

trial.label: Igeragezwa/Ikibazo
options: Yafungiwe mu cyobo kirekire n'abavandimwe be
Kuzerera mu buhungiro kuva mu gihugu cy'iwabo

outcome.label: Ibisubizo
options: Yazamutse ajya mu mwanya wo hejuru w'ubwami
Yavuye mu nda y'ifi nini agana ahantu hatekanye
Yayoboye abantu mu nyanja yari yaragabanyijemo kabiri

arabic: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ أَهْلَهُۥ وَمِثْلَهُم مَّعَهُمْ رَحْمَةًۭ مِّنَّا وَذِكْرَىٰ لِأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَـٰبِ
verse: And We granted him his family and a like [number] with them as mercy from Us and a reminder for those of understanding. (38:43)
